title: 3-round AES-128: One-active-byte bottleneck relation

target.description: AES-128 on 128-bit blocks. Consecutive inner rounds each include MixColumns; the round keys are fixed and unknown. The source explicitly specifies left-going ShiftRows.

setting.key_relation: Three fixed, unknown 128-bit round keys. The structural argument does not use their master-key dependencies, and therefore also applies to keys derived from any of the standard AES key lengths.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no restriction to a weak-key family
setting.plaintext_model: Fix the other twelve input bytes; vary y at Y_(0,3) and use c=(c0,c1,c2) at Y_(1,3),Y_(2,3),Y_(3,3) as a parameter.

property.statement: The induced one-byte function s_c(y) is described by five c-independent key-dependent byte parameters and four c/key-dependent byte parameters. Equal parameter tuples give equal functions over all 256 y values.
property.quantifier: For fixed unknown round keys and fixed twelve input bytes, equality of the four internal parameters is sufficient for s_c(y)=s_c'(y) for every y. Finding distinct colliding c values uses a random-function heuristic; no probability-one guarantee for every key is asserted.
property.scope: Three internal AES rounds; projected byte-valued functions, not a collision of complete ciphertext blocks or AES master keys.

parameters.name: Fixed key-dependent bytes
parameters.meaning: Four first-stage offsets and one final projected-key offset in the source representation.

parameters.name: Parameter-dependent bytes
parameters.meaning: The internal tuple depending on c and the fixed unknown round keys.

parameters.name: Function domain
parameters.meaning: One colliding pair agrees pointwise over this domain; this is not an oracle-query budget.

validation.description: The published dependency argument is retained with its heuristic collision-existence step. No universal existence theorem or full collision-search reproduction is claimed.
